Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I'll be away from the computer from tomorrow (29-JUN-2000) through
Monday 10-JUL-2000, for Dragon*Con among other things.

Please save your questions for my return, or post your questions
in the interim in the hopes that some of the other newsgroup
personalities will be able to answer them.

To those of you who are in a position to answer questions in my
absence, may I request that you offer rulebook, webpage, or RTR
citations when possible in order to reduce the need for me to
acknowledge the answers upon my return? Thanks.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/
